receipt.inference_inputs: Only official normalized state/questions; no evaluation metadata or data files
receipt.native_component: Actual native systemOne executed every request; native original and baseline100 answers retained
receipt.architecture: Actual native RuVector BGE/core ranking of a complete legal-source partition; ranked anchors plus immediate same-paragraph context packed under512 tokens; unchanged DeBERTa-base singleton NLI. Matched same-policy lexical/positional arms. Native104 reads the exact primary excerpt, not original full input. Legacy top2 arm names are compatibility aliases; each ranking contains at most40 anchor candidates. Same-paragraph neighbor expansion may inspect additional units identically for all3 arms under the same512-token budget.

config.hypothesis: Complete legal source units plus immediate same-paragraph context improve evidence use compared with arbitrary overlapping fixed-token windows.
config.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

source_partition.paragraph_boundary: blank-line break, including its exact whitespace
source_partition.atom_boundary: sentence or semicolon followed by whitespace
source_partition.oversize_policy: Explicit observed NLI token-offset fallback, complete source retained

config.ranking_depth_scope: min(40, total_units) anchor candidates for native, lexical and positional arms; same-paragraph neighbor expansion may inspect additional units under the same512-token budget
config.packing: Scan ranked anchors; add complete anchor if it fits, then previous and next same-paragraph units if they fit; concatenate merged selected spans in source order
config.decoder: Unchanged pinned candidate4 DeBERTa-base singleton, no padding, no truncation
config.legacy_arm_names: ruvector_top2/same_nli_lexical_top2/same_nli_positional_first2 are interface aliases; epoch6 ranks up to40 anchor candidates, may inspect same-paragraph neighbors outside that ranking, and packs a variable number identically under512 tokens

resources_before_initialization.accounting: Self, already-terminated children and still-live native104 are separate observations; no double-counted total CPU claim.

resources_after_initialization.accounting: Self, already-terminated children and still-live native104 are separate observations; no double-counted total CPU claim.

receipt.batch_policy: Exactly one allowed composite corpus batch shared by DEV24 and conditionally-gated96, total600seconds; caller controls deadline and no retry.
receipt.reused_model_and_decoder: Exact frozen epoch4 DeBERTa-base singleton/T1; no new weights, fit or calibration
receipt.source_policy: Full nonoverlapping paragraph/sentence partition; explicit oversize token-offset fallback; each arm ranks at most40 anchor candidates and may inspect additional same-paragraph neighbors through identical512-token packing
receipt.adaptive_history: Prior epoch5 used this same model and decoder; epoch6 changes context handling only. No fresh labels were inspected during candidate implementation.

initial_resources.peak_memory_scope: Linux getrusage process high-water marks; child maximum is not sum or simultaneous total memory
